From 3a71cd6ca0ce33d1af019ecf1d7167406fa54400 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Md Haris Iqbal <haris.iqbal@ionos.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2023 16:41:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/rtrs-srv: Free srv_mr iu only when always_invalidate is
 true

Since srv_mr->iu is allocated and used only when always_invalidate is
true, free it only when always_invalidate is true.

Fixes: 9cb837480424 ("RDMA/rtrs: server: main functionality")
Signed-off-by: Md Haris Iqbal <haris.iqbal@ionos.com>
Signed-off-by: Jack Wang <jinpu.wang@ionos.com>
Signed-off-by: Grzegorz Prajsner <grzegorz.prajsner@ionos.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20231120154146.920486-5-haris.iqbal@ionos.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/ulp/rtrs/rtrs-srv.c b/drivers/infiniband/ulp/rtrs/rtrs-srv.c
index 4be0e5b132d4..925b71481c62 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/ulp/rtrs/rtrs-srv.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/ulp/rtrs/rtrs-srv.c
@@ -551,7 +551,10 @@ static void unmap_cont_bufs(struct rtrs_srv_path *srv_path)
 		struct rtrs_srv_mr *srv_mr;
 
 		srv_mr = &srv_path->mrs[i];
-		rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
+
+		if (always_invalidate)
+			rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
+
 		ib_dereg_mr(srv_mr->mr);
 		ib_dma_unmap_sg(srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, srv_mr->sgt.sgl,
 				srv_mr->sgt.nents, DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/infiniband/ulp/rtrs/rtrs-srv.c`**
- The code was modified in the `unmap_cont_bufs` function.
- The line that frees the `srv_mr->iu` memory was changed to include a conditional check. It now only calls `rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);` if the variable `always_invalidate` is true.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to memory management by ensuring that the `srv_mr->iu` is only freed when it is actually allocated and used, which is determined by the `always_invalidate` condition. This change prevents potential memory leaks or invalid memory access when `always_invalidate` is false. The patch is a direct fix for the functionality introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `9cb837480424`).

Here is the commit message:
RDMA/rtrs-srv: Free srv_mr iu only when always_invalidate is
 true

Since srv_mr->iu is allocated and used only when always_invalidate is
true, free it only when always_invalidate is true.

Fixes: 9cb837480424 ("RDMA/rtrs: server: main functionality")
Signed-off-by: Md Haris Iqbal <haris.iqbal@ionos.com>
Signed-off-by: Jack Wang <jinpu.wang@ionos.com>
Signed-off-by: Grzegorz Prajsner <grzegorz.prajsner@ionos.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20231120154146.920486-5-haris.iqbal@ionos.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the unconditional freeing of the `srv_mr->iu` memory in the `unmap_cont_bufs` function, regardless of whether it was allocated for use. This can lead to attempts to free memory that is not allocated or is no longer valid, particularly when the `always_invalidate` condition is false, resulting in potential memory leaks or access violations.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void unmap_cont_bufs(struct rtrs_srv_path *srv_path)
 {
 	int i;
 
 	for (i = 0; i < srv_path->mrs_num; i++) {
 		struct rtrs_srv_mr *srv_mr;
 
 		srv_mr = &srv_path->mrs[i];
-		rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
+
+		if (always_invalidate)
+			rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
+
 		ib_dereg_mr(srv_mr->mr);
 		ib_dma_unmap_sg(srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, srv_mr->sgt.sgl,
 				srv_mr->sgt.nents, DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL);
 		sg_free_table(&srv_mr->sgt);
 	}
 	kfree(srv_path->mrs);
 }

```c
rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
```
Reason:
The unconditional call to `rtrs_iu_free` attempts to free the `srv_mr->iu` memory without checking if it was allocated for use, which can lead to freeing unallocated or invalid memory when `always_invalidate` is false, causing potential memory leaks or access violations.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (always_invalidate)
    rtrs_iu_free(srv_mr->iu, srv_path->s.dev->ib_dev, 1);
```
Reason:
By adding a conditional check for `always_invalidate`, the code ensures that `rtrs_iu_free` is only called when it is safe to do so, preventing the freeing of memory that was not allocated, thus avoiding memory leaks or access violations.
